scope: Source and file-only review of assessment arithmetic, exact raw anchoring, fixed schedule membership, unit screens and reporting. Separate reviewer owns full build/run/custody review. No package script imported or executed; no build, solver, compiler, native or GPU work.

arithmetic.aggregate: 100*(sum of three baseline fixture medians - sum of three candidate fixture medians)/sum of baseline fixture medians; unrounded comparison >=1.0.
arithmetic.pairs: Each pair uses the sum of its three complete-cycle observations. At least13/16 strictly positive millisecond differences; positive baseline denominator makes sign equivalent to paired percentage gain. Exact zero is a tie and never a win.
arithmetic.robustness: Median paired percentage gain >0, every four-pair block percentage-gain median >0 and both eight-pair BC/CB percentage-gain medians >0. No additional1% paired or0.5% block cutoff.
arithmetic.fixture_guard: Reject a fixture only when candidate fixture median exceeds baseline fixture median AND at least9/16 corresponding paired fixture times are strictly slower. Equality at either strict-positive boundary does not trigger.
arithmetic.combination: All six gate booleans must pass. Original comparator2%/3% fields exist only under its performance object, which assess.py:88 replaces completely before any output.
arithmetic.descriptions: Every raw paired gain/difference, block and order group is retained; count/median/min/max/range/unscaled median absolute deviation plus explicit win/tie/loss counts. No p-value, confidence or calibrated familywise-error claim.

exactness.raw_result: common.py:129 pins stdout, parses all3 AUTORESEARCH_RESULT objects, requires exact report equality and frozen fixture order/stops/target. Only six named timing fields are excluded; every remaining config/state/fingerprint/stop/result field equals frozen E020C1.
exactness.checkpoints: All23 convergence records per process match the frozen E020C1 ordered trajectory. The fixed evaluator emits exactly five non-timing fields beyond constant stage: fixture_id, iteration, exploit_bits, exploit_pct_pot, exploit_chips; all are compared. Only solve_checks_elapsed_ms is omitted.
exactness.unit_screens: Fresh five binaries are screened before measurements; summary84/0/4/0/0 for E020/E007/E008 and85/0/4/0/0 for E032/E036. Exact binary/manifests/source/environment are checked. E032 focused geometry test is present; E036 focused test and exactly one34-pair/68-launch/128-thread exact marker are required.
exactness.anchor: E020C1 contributes correctness payload only; none of its timings enter summary cohorts.
exactness.retention: All128 fixed measurements must exist and validate. No outcome-based sample exclusion, replacement, extension, old-pooling or automatic acceptance path.

schedule_check.orientation_randomization_note: This review verifies frozen balance/membership and adjacent ordering. Seed-generation provenance is covered by the separate run/custody reviewer.

cost_and_qualification: A timing pass is explicitly qualifying_pending_cost_and_broader_gates. It is not proof of cost-free behavior. Independent raw audit, material memory/capacity/compatibility evidence, broader F32/state/menu/continuation controls, prospective wide-turn holdout and fresh cumulative qualification remain required.
review_method: Complete source read of assess.py and common.py exact_raw/unit_check plus reused comparator validate_run/summarize and fixed evaluator checkpoint schema; independent file-only schedule cardinality checks and AST parsing. No synthetic outcome is represented as a measured sample.
resolved_preseal_requests: Root-requested MAD and explicit wins/ties/losses added as reporting only.
Separate reviewer requested unit binary/provenance tightening; present in final common.py.
